title: Two agents edit different functions of the same file
note: They race. The earlier qualifying push lands; the other rebases. Git merges the non-overlapping hunks.

agents.instructions: In calc.py, change add so it returns a + b + 1. Do not change mul. Land that change on the shared repo. If your push loses a race, rebase and land again.
In calc.py, change mul so it returns a * b * 2. Do not change add. Land that change on the shared repo. If your push loses a race, rebase and land again.
